mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate relative to 6 months prior signals monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and producing positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate below 3.5% signals a tight labor market supporting strong consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 55% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5%, or the signal's Rank IC is negative over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous 2-month increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand driving corporate earnings growth and positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive returns in more than 40% of instances, or the correlation between the signal and returns is negative.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of high inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 5.0%) and high interest rates (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%), restrictive monetary policy suppresses equity valuations, causing negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 5.0% and FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or the signal's Rank IC is positive.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 6-month upward trend in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer confidence and economic expansion, producing positive 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for HOUST trend is below 0.02 over any 1-year window, or 5-day returns are not significantly positive when HOUST rises.

mechanism_narrative: Payroll employment above 160,000 thousand persons signals a robust labor market sustaining high consumer spending, leading to positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS > 160000, or the signal's Rank IC is negative.

mechanism_narrative: A joint 3-month increase in industrial production (INDPRO) and GDP growth (GDPC1) signals strong economic output driving positive 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: The interaction signal fails to produce positive returns in more than 45% of instances, or the correlation between the signal and 5-day returns is negative.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of slowing industrial production (INDPRO growth < 0.5% monthly) and rising unemployment (UNRATE > 4.0%), economic slowdown suppresses corporate earnings, causing negative 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO growth < 0.5% and UNRATE > 4.0%, or the signal's Rank IC is positive.
